title: Basie band pay and laughing on the bandstand
summary: Pay started at $35, rose to $50 and $75 and reached about $125. Humes and Jimmy Rushing joked on the bandstand until Basie sent them to the dressing room.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: $35. And eventually it went up to $50, and then it went up to $75. I think when I left I was making a $125, or something like that.
Were you, yeah? Because you were being starred by then.
We used to just have a ball. And
